note: Phrasings the hand-written operator grammars miss, mapped to the same typed operator nodes (parameters validated by each engine).

rules.description: Did a monitored rate jump out of its normal range for any unit (SPC control chart)

plan.purpose: Control chart of {series.value} by {group.value}; signals in the reported window

positives.question: Did the denial rate for any payer jump out of its normal range in the last month?

negatives: Did the denial rate for any payer jump out of its normal range because of coding changes?
Did the no-show rate for any clinic jump out of its normal range?

rules.description: Which denial reasons cost the most dollars, by payer or provider (denial Pareto)
rules.pattern: ^which denial (?:reasons|codes|categories) (?:cost|cost us|lose us|lost us) the most (?:dollars|money|revenue) {period?},? (?:by|per|for each) {by}$

plan.purpose: Denial patterns in dollars by reason and {by.value}

positives.question: Which denial reasons cost us the most dollars this year, by payer?

negatives: Which denial reasons cost us the most dollars this year, by payer, and why?
Which denial reasons are most common?

rules.description: Revenue lost to payer take-backs and reprocessed claims (leakage review)
rules.pattern: ^how much (?:revenue|money) did we (?:lose|lost) to (?:payer )?(?:take-?backs|claw-?backs|recoupments)(?: and (?:reprocessed|reworked|resubmitted|reversed) claims)? {period?}$

plan.purpose: Revenue leakage in dollars: take-backs, reversals and rework

positives.question: How much revenue did we lose to payer take-backs and reprocessed claims this year?

negatives: How much revenue did we lose to payer take-backs and reprocessed claims this year compared with last year?
How much revenue did we lose to no-shows this year?

rules.description: Probable duplicate claims (claims review duplicate flags)
rules.pattern: ^which (?:medical )?claims are (?:probable|possible|likely|suspected|potential) duplicates(?:,? billed by the same or (?:a )?different providers?)? {period?}$

plan.purpose: Duplicate-billing review flags ranked by expected dollars

positives.question: Which claims are probable duplicates billed by the same or different providers?

negatives: Which claims are probable duplicates and should be voided?

rules.description: Claims paid below comparable claims for the same service and payer (underpayment review)
rules.pattern: ^which claims were paid (?:below|less than|under) (?:comparable|similar) claims for the same service and payer(?: \(possible underpayments\))? {period?}$

plan.purpose: Claims paid below comparable claims (same service and payer), ranked by expected dollars

positives.question: Which claims were paid below comparable claims for the same service and payer (possible underpayments)?

negatives: Which claims were paid below comparable claims for the same service and payer, and why?
Which claims were paid below contract?

rules.description: Providers billing unusually high units or codes compared with peers
rules.pattern: ^which (?:providers|clinicians|physicians) bill unusually high (?:units|codes|units or codes|volumes?) (?:compared (?:with|to)|relative to|vs\.?|versus) (?:their )?(?:specialty )?peers {period?}$

plan.purpose: Providers whose billing differs from peers (FDR-controlled), ranked by expected dollars

positives.question: Which providers bill unusually high units or codes compared with their specialty peers?

negatives: Which providers bill unusually high units or codes compared with their specialty peers after adjusting for case mix?
Which providers bill E/M level 5 visits far more often than their peers?

rules.description: Which patients are predicted to have an admission or ED visit within the next 1-6 months (precursor signatures)

plan.purpose: Patients whose recent multichannel pattern matches the signature that precedes {outcome.value} within {horizon.value} months

positives.question: Which members are predicted to have an admission in the next 90 days?

negatives: Which members are predicted to have an admission in the next 90 days and should be called first?
Which members are predicted to have an admission in the next two years?

rules.description: Patients whose lab trend is projected to cross a threshold (or a KDIGO eGFR stage) within a horizon
rules.pattern: ^which {population} have (?:an? |their )?{measurement} (?:declining|dropping|falling|rising|climbing) (?:fast enough )?to (?:reach|cross|fall below|drop below|exceed|rise above) {target} within (?:the next )?{horizon}$

plan.purpose: Kalman-forecast {measurement.value} trajectories crossing {target.value} within {horizon.value} days among {population.text}

positives.question: Which patients with CKD have eGFR declining fast enough to reach stage 4 within two years?

negatives: Which patients with CKD have eGFR declining fast enough to reach stage 4 within two years and why?
Which patients with CKD have eGFR declining fast enough to need dialysis?
